vulnerability_title: [M-04] DoS in Liquidity Migration due to Unit Mismatch in UniswapPriceOracle

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: validatePrice scales the price deviation by 1e16 and then compares it with slippage, which callers pass as a whole percentage. Almost any deviation therefore fails the check.
patterns_found: 1e16-scaled deviation compared with a raw percentage
issues: The failing caller, LiquidityManagerETH.convertToV3, is in another file; the unit mismatch itself is in this file.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: unit mismatch in oracle slippage check blocks liquidity migration
